evidence:
Reviewed only quality row 29. Frozen task paths below are relative to .qc-cache/hireops-2026-10-01-transaction-hardening-r1/task. Workbook Quality Checks!A30:D30 requires real render/constraints gates plus a zeroing gate in every scored prompt, with no same-origin restriction. Internal Quality Checks!A30:D30 retains historical cross-origin wording; the authoritative current quality sheet, skill public-network profile and current policy supersede that wording.

The real gate is explicit and meaningful: tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23 requires an incorrect password to remain signed out followed by successful correct-password sign-in, substantive navigation/readable content and no fatal error; a static picture or health response is insufficient. tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:23-26 requires UI creation of a new uniquely identified requisition AND its PENDING offer, then exactly one of each with matching identity/association/entered values in an independent empty signed-in browser context. It explicitly rejects static seed responses, no-op success, browser-only writes and requisition-only apps. tests/gates/constraints/prompt.md:7 supplies the actual newContext recipe, forbids same-context reload as persistence, and requires ordinary UI creation/readback. Its line 9 does not infer SQLite or require private source/API structure. Both gates are binary all_pass (judge.toml:14-20).

Every scored dimension has its own successful sign-in, UI creation and independent-context readback prerequisite: tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:9, polish/prompt.md:7 and visual/prompt.md:7. Failure hard-zeros every criterion at functional:11 and polish:8; visual:8 uses raw Likert 1, the minimum for its shipped five-point scale, and explicitly states normalized zero. They do not substitute a same-origin or CDN check. tests/scoring.toml:1-3 gives both real gates zero reward mass; tests/test.sh:213-224 checks gates/scorer before the scored suite; tests/tools/score.py:40-48 zeroes shaped reward on gate failure. No same-origin/cross-origin restriction occurs in the reviewed gates or scored prompts.

Counterexamples considered: a polished login/workspace with static seed reads and a no-op HTTP200 create cannot supply the unique records to the fresh context; a browser-only localStorage implementation cannot share that newly saved state with the empty context. The recorded local gate witness actually exercises the no-op case: local/gate-witness/results.json reports HTTP200 but reqSaved=false, freshReq=false, freshOffer=false and basic_gate_observations_satisfied=false. The same driver records the working golden with requisition/offer/fresh-context/PENDING observations true. Its dead_approval variant still satisfies the minimal creation gate while the real attempted approval remains disabled; that is intended separation of basic operability from scored settlement, not a static-shell escape. A conforming app with generated IDs, different routes/labels, equivalent date/money formatting, initially empty optional operational data or external browser assets is not falsely rejected: gate constraints:23-25 permits generated IDs/representations and forbids exact routes/labels, render:23 and visual prompt:8 allow empty collections, and no gate forbids external assets. The gate does not demand advanced approval/revision economics.

Verified evidence hashes against the current raw index: gate-witness.cjs 08ee689584d24a97a8446fb32ca0c4f9d3df100bd6eec14560c4fa63ad8ae31c; gate-witness/results.json fd8410bc91102874ef98edfdbacf19f7853687956e076acc684d36c565d9ec75; gate-witness.log 1c63a7bb4e868a981b21f7df7e98531aedb5d921cf890f239ea71bd93ec33706; mcp/results.json bad8d80ee96bda6a46775d4dfcc508371b96c50e3106cd9f4e27ffee1a6e4cc3; verification-local.json c861a763d89fa772ed90cf5b1db94b5ca538ad692fa3bcd8cbcd465df1c29fa6. All 37 source hashes in verification-local.json match the current frozen task; all 13 before/after app hashes in mcp/results.json match the frozen app. The recorded gate command mounts this frozen solution read-only and executes /evidence/gate-witness.cjs in hireops-verifier:20261001-hard-r1, exit 0. The MCP 0.0.79 record demonstrates browser_run_code_unsafe/newContext, separate Auditor UI sign-in, and retrieval of the created requisition and exact saved budget.

Run scope is PARTIAL: source gate correctness and finite local browser/MCP witnesses are supported, including a weak no-op fixture. The gate witness does not independently assert every preserved field or exercise the incorrect-password leg, and none of these artifacts is a configured LLM judge result. This Pass is limited to row 29's gate presence and correctness; it makes no Oracle, provider score, workload, full-suite completion or portal claim and does not waive those separate required measurements.
